title: Inflatable Air Sofa – Portable Lounge Bag
descriptionHtml:
A comfy lounge spot wherever you want

On the beach, at a festival or in the park it's nice to have something soft to sit on. But lugging chairs and cushions around is both heavy and awkward.

Fills with air in seconds

This air sofa fills when you swoop it through the air – no pump needed. It holds up to 200 kg and folds up small when you're done.

Features

  • Fills with air without a pump
  • Holds up to 200 kg
  • Foldable and easy to carry
  • With storage bag and pillow
  • Great for beach, camping and park

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
